notes: E-019 with E-020 and C-001 is used to distinguish scoped general-purpose MCU leadership from broad automotive semiconductor share; no company-wide leadership is inferred.
E-021, E-022 and E-023 with C-003 distinguish customer commitments and capacity investment from quantified switching costs or independently verified current SiC share leadership.
E-017 and E-018 distinguish current PIC100 high-volume production evidence from the forward-looking greater-than-$2bn 2027 AI revenue target and retain undisclosed customer concentration/economics.
E-008 is used only as a candidate bargaining-power weak link; the output does not infer customer leverage from concentration alone.

ASTRA labels all three priority findings SUPPORTED because each claim is narrowly phrased around what the packet establishes or fails to establish. This is not a stronger moat conclusion than SOL's MIXED labels on broader formulations.

C-003 remains UNRESOLVED_IN_PACKET, the unresolved questions remain explicit, and the output stays ASSIST-only without a final moat, durability, runway, valuation, score, routing or investment conclusion.

paired_observation_same_case.interpretation: All four STMicroelectronics outputs are comparison-admissible under their controlled Phase B profiles. ASTRA is materially more expensive and slower, and produces the longest visible output and highest reasoning-token count. On this single case it adds useful scoping precision, but the evidence does not establish a model winner or a quality-cost routing rule.
